mentions.name: CrateDiggr
mentions.description: A Chrome and Firefox extension that makes finding and downloading free downloads on Soundcloud easier. It highlights free downloads in the Soundcloud UI and automatically clicks through the download gates (like, comment, repost requirements) for users.
mentions.problem: Artists make users jump through hoops to like, comment, repost etc. before giving them access to the download.
mentions.audience: People who download tracks from Soundcloud
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a Chrome (& Firefox) extension to make finding and downloading Free DLs on Soundcloud easier.

https://cratediggr.com/

Artists make users jump through hoops to like, comment, repost etc.. before giving them access to the download - CrateDiggr highlights the free downloads in the Soundcloud UI and clicks through the download gates for users.
